tests.name: 4903真实2090首次出战只授第一项两回25%红伤上限，固定50不受限且第三回实际到期
tests.assertion: test('4903真实2090首次出战只授第一项两回25%红伤上限，固定50不受限且第三回实际到期',()=>{const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{spd:1},bStats:{spa:9999},loadout:[20155,14102,20082,29352,38393]});turn(s,20155,10716);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),2250);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),50);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,2200);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entries,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.capUntil,2);turn(s,20155,20117);turn(s,20155,10716);assert.ok(sum(s,'attack',1)>2250);});

tests.name: 4903真实2090高体回初只弱攻特攻速，任一项实际下降即成功，全部失败才刷新首次登场并清异常
tests.assertion: test('4903真实2090高体回初只弱攻特攻速，任一项实际下降即成功，全部失败才刷新首次登场并清异常',()=>{for(const mode of['success','partial','immune']){const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;if(mode==='partial'){s.fighters[1].stages.atk=-6;s.fighters[1].stages.spa=-6;}if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'免弱');turn(s,20155,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,mode==='immune'?2:1);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],mode!=='immune');assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.spe,mode==='immune'?0:-1);}});

tests.name: 4903真实2090实际首次出战不因弱化失败重授而虚增出战计数，前五次真实刷新，第六次明确Q001回滚
tests.assertion: test('4903真实2090实际首次出战不因弱化失败重授而虚增出战计数，前五次真实刷新，第六次明确Q001回滚',()=>{const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true});timer(s,1,'免弱');for(let r=1;r<=4;r++){turn(s,20155,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,r+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entries,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.capUntil,r+1);}assert.throws(()=>turn(s,20155,null),/Q-4903-001/);assert.equal(s.round,5);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.emperor4903.entryTriggers,5);});

tests.name: 4903真实2090严格高于300完整红伤才理论吸取3000，300不吸且回末特攻速度各一；临终过量红也按完整伤害判断

tests.name: 4903真实2090实际用出攻击MISS或整招无效低体Q004明确拒绝，控制未用不触发吸取，仍可未高红战阶强化
tests.assertion: test('4903真实2090实际用出攻击MISS或整招无效低体Q004明确拒绝，控制未用不触发吸取，仍可未高红战阶强化',()=>{for(const mode of['miss','invalid','control']){const s=make({move:14102,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='miss')timer(s,0,'攻击必失');if(mode==='invalid')s.fighters[0].counts.nextSkillInvalid=1;if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;if(mode==='control'){turn(s,14102,20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,1);}else{assert.throws(()=>turn(s,14102,20117),/Q-4903-004/);assert.equal(s.round,1);}}});

tests.name: 4903真实2090同回合第二次正红触及不同上限单位时Q002回滚，低总量重放不误阻塞
tests.assertion: test('4903真实2090同回合第二次正红触及不同上限单位时Q002回滚，低总量重放不误阻塞',()=>{for(const high of[false,true]){const s=make({move:20155,index:-1,soul:true,hp:4500,aStats:{def:high?1:300,spd:high?1:300},bStats:{atk:high?9999:180,spa:high?9999:180}}),old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const r=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===1&&c.m.id===key(10716))c.reproduceSkillComponent(c.moveDefinition(key(10127)));return r;}};try{if(high){assert.throws(()=>turn(s,20155,10716),/Q-4903-002/);assert.equal(s.round,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4500);}else{turn(s,20155,10716);assert.equal(s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===1).length,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,4500-sum(s,'attack',1)-50);}}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}}});
